brief:
Israeli soldiers marked Palestinian detainees with numbers written on their foreheads and arms during a raid in Qabatiya, near Jenin in the occupied West Bank on Monday, Middle East Eye reported. The practice occurred as Israeli forces conducted operations in the area targeting the town near one of the West Bank's flashpoint regions.

The numbering of detainees during military operations raises immediate questions about identification and processing methods used by Israeli forces in Palestinian territories. Human rights organizations have documented repeated accusations of mistreatment during detention operations in the West Bank. The incident adds to a pattern of complaints regarding treatment of Palestinians taken into custody by Israeli military personnel during raids and arrests.
